# Fred J. Hickernell

::: {.affiliation}
Professor of Applied Mathematics\
Illinois Institute of Technology
:::

::: {.lead-copy}
I study how to make computational answers more efficient and more reliable,
especially when a problem involves many variables or uncertain inputs.
My work connects Monte Carlo and quasi-Monte Carlo methods, numerical
approximation, and scientific software.
:::

## Bio {#bio}

::: {.bio}
Much of my career has been at Hong Kong Baptist University and Illinois
Institute of Technology.

Family is an important part of my life. I am a follower of Christ and a member
of [Wheaton Chinese Alliance Church](https://www.wcac-cma.org/). My years living
in Hong Kong are also part of my story.
:::
